description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.command class, which represents a command that can be executed within the CKEditor rich text editor. It includes methods for executing, enabling, disabling, setting state, and toggling the command's active state, as well as handling command-related events.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.command
classes.description: A class representing a command that can be executed on an editor instance, with methods to control its state and behavior.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the command for execution, restoring its previous state if it was disabled.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the command, setting its state to CKEDITOR.TRISTATE_DISABLED.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the command's state to a new value and fires a 'state' event if the state changes.

methods.name: toggleState
methods.description: Toggles the command's state between active (ON) and inactive (OFF).
